body:
### Summary

In our multi-package repo, at the root pyproject level we define

```
[tool.uv]
default-groups = ["dev", "local-spark"]
# local-spark (classic pyspark) and the databricks extra (Spark Connect client) both
# provide the pyspark namespace and cannot be installed together.
conflicts = [[{ group = "local-spark"}, { extra = "databricks" }]]
```

on uv 0.9 it is working fine.
We upgraded to 0.11 and now receive the error
`error: Expected `package` field in conflicting entry: { group = "local-spark" }`

Same in 0.12.

Seems like defining top-level conflicts does not inherit them in actual workspaces.

Tested with --all-packages switch, same.

### Platform

Windows 11 x64

### Version

0.12.9 (9f9286029 2026-09-01 x86_64-pc-windows-msvc)

### Python version

Python 3.12.10
title: Regression: conflicts definition in root project are not inherited
